item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 18 November 2026(Wednesday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Batangas (Nasugbu, Lian, Balayan, Tuy, and Calatagan), Bulacan (San Jose del Monte, Norzagaray, and Dona Remedios Trinidad), Metro Manila (Caloocan, Malabon, Navotas, Valenzuela, Quezon City, Makati, Mandaluyong, Pasig, San Juan, Pateros, Marikina, Manila, Taguig, and Pasay), Quezon (General Nakar, Lopez, Calauag, Macalelon, Gumaca, Pitogo, General Luna, Catanauan, Unisan, Plaridel, Panukulan, Burdeos, Polillo, Jomalig, and Patnanungan), and Rizal (Rodriguez, San Mateo, Cainta, and Antipolo) within the next 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
